facts.summary: Phase 3 met primary endpoint but modest response rates; all-oral arm weak · Phase 3 · lonafarnib in hepatitis delta · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Both treatment arms achieved statistical significance over placebo in the composite primary endpoint as well as the component virologic and biochemical responses.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Both treatment arms achieved statistical significance over placebo in the composite primary endpoint as well as the component virologic and biochemical responses.
evidence.safety: There were two deaths in the study: one patient treated with peginterferon alfa died due to decompensated cirrhosis that was attributed to drug therapy.
